name: North-star: Grouped Bars

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT model,
  sum(PromptTokens) AS prompt,
  sum(CompletionTokens) AS completion
FROM (
  SELECT TraceId, arrayJoin(Models) AS model, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
    AND TotalDurationMs > 0
)
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY prompt + completion DESC
LIMIT 8
